entities.summary: William Hunt "Bill" Gross is an American investor and retired fund manager, who co-founded Pacific Investment Management Co. PIMCO is a global fixed income investment company. Gross ran their $270 billion Total Return Fund (PTTRX), before leaving to join Janus Capital Group in September 2014. Gross retired from active fund management in 2019.
